q0.q: Will this bra really stay up all day?
q0.a: Yes — our stay-put silicone grip is designed to lock the bra in place against your skin, even through movement, heat, and long days. Most customers report wearing it 8–10 hours with zero adjustment.

q1.a: The Truekind® Convertible Strapless Bandeau Bra runs from XS through 3X. Use our size and fit guide — it maps traditional bra sizes to our band/cup fit.

q2.q: Can I wear it with regular straps too?
q2.a: Absolutely. It comes with removable, adjustable straps that clip on in seconds — so one bra works strapless, with straps, or in halter/crossback configurations.

q3.q: Is it comfortable for larger busts?
q3.a: Yes. Soft side boning provides structure and lift without poking or squeezing, and the wide band distributes weight so you get real support without underwire digging in.

q4.a: Hand wash cold, line dry. Avoid bleach, ironing, and dry cleaning — this protects the bonded silicone grip so it keeps performing wash after wash.
